name: mods
description: Claude Code interface mods by kadragon. Claude Code only; built on the early-access function-hooks API.

statusBandEnabled.title: Status band
statusBandEnabled.description: Show the model, effort, directory, git branch, session time, prompt-cache time left, hook, skill and MCP server counts, context fill, rate limits, a due harness-curate run, and — in a harness repo — the task cycle on the branch (contract, evidence, PR and CI, with a toast when CI settles) and the backlog queue depth above the prompt.

statusBandCacheTtlMinutes.title: Status band cache TTL (minutes)
statusBandCacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache is taken to live after a response, for the status band's countdown: 60, or 5 where the session runs on the short cache.

statusBandAscii.title: Status band in plain ASCII
statusBandAscii.description: Draw the status band's separators, effort mark, context bar and cut branch names in ASCII, for a terminal that leaves stale cells or broken glyphs behind on redraw (Wave on Windows).

prRecapEnabled.title: PR recap pane
prRecapEnabled.description: Open a side pane (about a quarter of the terminal) with the latest merged PR of the branch history: its numbers, a plain-language summary and a top-to-bottom diagram of the parts it touches, made once per commit by a small model (Haiku) and kept. With the pane focused, p and n step to the older and newer of the last 20 PRs. It rereads after a git merge, pull or checkout. /pr-recap opens it again.

contractPaneEnabled.title: Sprint Contract in the PR recap pane
contractPaneEnabled.description: Draw this branch's Sprint Contract, as the dev plugin archived it, on top of the PR recap pane: each acceptance criterion marked passed, failed or unchecked by the recorded validation run whose command is exactly its check, whether those runs still match the working tree, and a flag when a stuck note is kept; one line where the branch has none. It rereads after a command of the cycle's own, and r rereads it. Needs the dev plugin and the PR recap pane.

prRecapExplain.title: PR recap summary by Haiku
prRecapExplain.description: Let the PR recap pane send each PR it shows: its commit message, file list and diff (cut at 16k characters) to Haiku through your Claude account, once per commit, for its plain summary and diagram. Off, nothing leaves the machine and the pane shows the commit message instead.
